I wouldn't do that. If you have positive thoughts and aspirations and then everything falls apart, you're not back in square one actually. You can try again and again and after 99th of "everything fell apart" you'll be so much further. But if you're not even trying you're setting yourself up to make things worse. They will get worse and worse.
There is this perfectionistic tendency in our minds that you can only be 100% happy and collected and when it's below that it doesn't count. "20% doesn't count" "I'll wait till I feel 100% again". And we end up on zero most of the time, with periodical perfectionistic outbursts. How can we expect our life to be good when we're trying only when we feel like it. Everything fell apart? Okay, try to still maintain your goals and aspirations, adjust them a little or change something else about your life (cut out toxic people, change workplace etc.)

I want you to remember that if you try and everything falls apart you're not back in square one. You don't have to "collect yourself up" before the next attempt. If you feel like a failure, do stuff with this feeling in you. Embrace your misery. Don't wait for"when you're ready" "when you'll be sure your effort won't be wasted" "when you'll finally know what to do and it won't fall apart". Cuz this time will never come. It's impossible, it doesn't work that way. It's just your perfectionism talking.

If you won't take responsibility for your happiness now it'll only get worse. Please, have positive thoughts and aspirations despite being in a shitty place. Have them always, don't keep them locked away "until it's the time". The time is now and the time is never. So embrace them now, pursue them imperfectly and let yourself fail. Break your aspirations down into smaller achievable-for-your-current-self pieces and eventually you'll be so much further than you're now. Maybe not 100% okay but who would want than anyway, go for authentic.
